name: mem0-local-admin
title_zh: 本地记忆库的定期体检与定向遗忘手术台
tagline_zh: 不放心云端记忆？它用确定性 CLI 给你本地 Mem0 做审计、定点遗忘和边界清理。只在你主动喊它时才动手。
tagline_en: Don't trust cloud memory? Audit, surgically forget, and tidy your local Mem0 via a deterministic CLI. Only acts.
desc_en: Review and safely maintain the user's localhost Mem0 store through the deterministic mem0-admin CLI. Use only when explicitly invoked for deep context, memory audits, targeted forgetting, or bounded dream cleanup; do not use for ordinary automatic recall or Cloud Mem0.
why_zh: 把记忆维护从黑盒 API 变成可审查的本地命令：每次遗忘都有明确边界，清理范围可预期。
why_en: Turns memory upkeep from a black-box API into auditable local commands: every forget has explicit bounds, cleanup is.
limit_zh: 只认 localhost 的 Mem0 存储，不碰 Cloud Mem0。
limit_en: Local Mem0 only, not Cloud. Requires mem0-admin CLI and reachable DB. Audits, targeted forgetting, dream cleanup—no auto-recall or writes.
title_en: Local Mem0 store: audit, forget, and tidy on demand
